entries.822f8df0493dd4a6: The company has been implementing its 19th Management Plan (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026) since fiscal 2024. Under the slogan 'Challenge, Toward the Future: 4 Cs', it has set management targets of 'Trust', 'Competitiveness', 'Execution' and 'Challenge', and aims to become a 'Meiko of Safety and Technology' and 'a company that employees can take pride in'. It is also advancing initiatives such as fostering a culture that puts safety first, improving quality control capabilities, transforming business execution methods through DX, promoting plans to build a training facility, investing in human capital and supporting employee engagement, and strategic order-taking aimed at expanding revenue. The company's motto is 'Sincerity' and 'Harmony without conformity'.
